Physical_Environment.Location: Tsinghua University, Beijing, China (ethics approval THU-04-2025-1135; participants recruited from a university sample)

Equipment.Software: PsychoPy 2022.2.4 (standalone PsychoPy experiment; psychopyVersion = 2022.2.4 recorded in every raw data file)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 3 (identity: general self, friend, stranger) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching), within-subjects; 60 trials per condition (shape identity x trial type)

Block_Structure.Block_number: 6 blocks (60 trials each; a self-paced rest screen followed trials 60, 120, 180, 240 and 300)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 360 trials total per participant (60 per condition; randomized order across the 6 blocks); all 360 trials are retained in the database, including no-response and RT < 200 ms trials
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: one criterion practice block with feedback, repeated until six consecutive correct responses (programme variable practice_times = 6); length varies between participants (6-335 trials, median 26; 2,421 practice trials in total across the 49 participants). Practice trials are flagged in the Clean file (Phase = practice) and were excluded from the authors' analyses.

Trial_Structure.Fixation_duration: 500 ms (fixation cross on grey background; the cross remains on screen while the shape-label pair is displayed, 600 ms in total)
Trial_Structure.SOA: 0 ms (shape and label presented simultaneously; shape above, label below, 3.5 deg apart)
Trial_Structure.ISI: 0 ms (simultaneous presentation of shape and label)
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1100 ms (blank screen from stimulus offset; only the keys z and m were accepted, 'reaction too slow' feedback otherwise)
Trial_Structure.ITI: not reported separately (the next trial starts with the 500 ms fixation cross)
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (feedback text in Chinese: 反应正确 correct / 反应错误 incorrect / 反应过慢 too slow)

Stimulus_Properties.Fixation: white fixation cross (+) on grey background (RGB 127, 127, 127), 500 ms
Stimulus_Properties.Shape: geometric shape images presented above the fixation cross: circle.png, rectangle.png (the file renders a white square of 214 x 213 px on a 300 x 300 px canvas, i.e. the 'square' of the article) and triangle.png; displayed at 2.4 deg x 2.4 deg. The shape-identity binding (conditions 1-6) and the response-key mapping (A/B) were counterbalanced across participants and are recorded per trial in the Clean file (Shape, Shape_Origin_Identity, Counterbalance)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Chinese identity words presented below the fixation cross at approx. 4.4 deg x 2.4 deg: 一般我 (general self), 朋友 (friend), 陌生人 (stranger)

Colors.Stimulus: white shapes and white text on grey background

exp2.detail: Experiment 2 of Zhao & Wang (2026, Psychon Bull Rev, DOI 10.3758/s13423-026-03000-8). Procedure identical to Experiment 1 except that the identity labels were 一般我 (general self), 朋友 (friend) and 陌生人 (stranger), testing whether general self-prioritization emerges when the true self is absent. Matching key counterbalanced with the shape-identity binding over 12 conditions (A: match = z, non-match = m; B: match = m, non-match = z), assigned randomly by the programme. DATA SOURCE AND REBUILD (2026-10-13): the standard files were rebuilt from the authors' original per-participant PsychoPy data files (Zhao_2026_PsychonBullRev_Raw/EXP2-general self spe/programming_files/data/*.csv, 49 files); the earlier version was derived from the authors' filtered OSF analysis file (osf.io/j2pxc, data/hddm_trial_data/exp2_hddm_trial_data.xlsx, 16,528 rows), which is retained in the input zone and is reproduced exactly by the rebuilt Clean file under the authors' filters (rows with a response and RT >= 200 ms, analysed participants only; verified as an exact trial-by-trial match on match / shape_identity / response / corr / rt / subj_idx). All participants with data are kept in the database (49; Sample_Size = 49): the authors excluded participants 14 and 49 for below-chance performance and analysed 47 (29 female; Mage 23.21, SD 3.67), so Valid_Subj = 47 and Drop_Subj = 2 in Dataset_inf.csv. ACC follows the database coding (1 = correct key, 0 = incorrect key, NA = no response; PsychoPy's corr = 0 on no-response trials is recoded to NA); Response/CorrResponse hold the physical keys z / m. Label identity is available for every trial, including nonmatching trials. Matching in this experiment is fully recoverable from the standardized layer (general self -> Self, friend -> Close, stranger -> Stranger). The matching-trials-only analyses reported in the article used the authors' own filtering (practice trials, no-response trials and RT < 200 ms trials removed). Demographics: this experiment's raw logs contain no age/gender fields (unlike Experiment 1); Age and Gender in the subj_info file therefore come from the authors' OSF behaviour questionnaire (exp2_behavior_questionnaire.xlsx), which covers the 47 analysed participants only - the two excluded participants (14, 49) have no demographic data in any shared file and their Age/Gender are recorded as '/'. Questionnaires after the task (online): BTS, SCS, SEB. Ethics: Tsinghua University Ethics Committee THU-04-2025-1135.
